source.source_locator: 教則 第3章 3.1.2(3)1)c「航空機又は他の無人航空機との衝突防止」（教則表示ページ22 / PDF viewer 27）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 飛行前に他の無人航空機の飛行を確認した場合は、相手の操縦者と飛行日時・経路・高度等を調整する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 他の無人航空機が飛んでいても、目視で避ける予定なら事前調整は不要である。
evidence.reasoning_path: preflight UAS traffic -> identify another operator -> coordinate time/route/altitude

collision.note: Tier A。Q170は飛行中に他の無人航空機等を継続監視する論点であり、飛行前の操縦者間調整義務は直接問っていない。

independent_review.rationale: 3.1.2(3)1)c explicitly requires preflight coordination of date/time, route and altitude when another UAS operation is identified. Existing canonical coverage monitors traffic but does not test this operator-to-operator coordination obligation.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the quality-preserving 400-question contract to the B7 Chapter 3 Rules set. All 15 Tier A candidates test explicit source propositions not represented by the current 215-question accepted/source-verified canonical bank. The five Tier B candidates C001, C003, C008, C013 and C015 remain materially distinct through source-defined flight-phase, authority/exception, operation-subtype, response-sequence or moving-vehicle boundaries. None is retained as wording-only variation, none relies on a subsection marked 〔一等〕, and none is accepted merely to fill a numeric quota.
